messages:
Priya (SE): Heads-up: ZenithBank POC starts tomorrow. Needs NDJSON streaming + in-stream tool calls that emit strict JSON records. Also quick pricing for a 2-week trial. Any blockers?
Tom (Sales Eng): Estimate ~70k tokens/day, bursts to 200k. They want predictable tail latency. Can we offer short reserved + burst credits?
Eve (Solutions): Recommend small reserved instance + burst pool. Turn batching off and enable kv_prefix_cache for low latency.
Jose (Security): They require SOC2, IP allowlist, STS ephemeral creds, and DPA. Hosted POC OK with invite accounts; Private requires infra ticket.
Priya (SE): Need short runnable snippets: SSE/WS NDJSON parsing, declare function/tool schema, handle tool_result, and resume handshake notes.
Eve (Solutions): One-pager + example repo incoming. Note: treat tool_result as canonical JSON; partial chunks may be invalid JSON.
Tom (Sales Eng): I'll ask Finance for a 2-week reserved-small quote with 3x burst and flat POC support fee.
Priya (SE): Node snippet:
```js
const stream = client.stream({model:'rwd-small', streaming:true, response_format:{type:'ndjson'}})
stream.on('data', e=>{ if(e.type==='tool_call') handle(JSON.parse(e.payload)); if(e.type==='tool_result') finalize(JSON.parse(e.payload)) })
stream.send({prompt:'...'})
```
Priya (SE): Resume: include header x-rwd-session + ?last_seq=N. Server replays cached KV up to seq. If resume fails, fallback to new session (may redo tokens).
Eve (Solutions): Schema enforcement via response_schema in request; invalid outputs surface as tool_result.error. Advise clients to run SDK validate_schema on post-processing to catch drift.
Jose (Security): We can enable audit logs and extended retention for the POC. Provide subprocessor list and SOC2.
build-bot: Example repo created: github.com/redwood/examples/zenith-ndjson (canary-20240316).
Tom (Sales Eng): Thanks. I'll update Zenith with invite accounts, subprocessor doc, and request the commit once Finance confirms price. :thumbsup:
Eve (Solutions): Action items: I -> one-pager + repo, Jose -> SOC2/subprocessor, Finance -> quote. Ping when done.
